title: erophaca baetica
intro: Erophaca baetica, commonly known as the Spanish broom or broom, is a flowering plant in the legume family. It is a shrub native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its medicinal properties. Erophaca baetica is said to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antiseptic and antifungal properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
